resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Central US page calls the 1943 tower a steel tower; the Cook County list calls it an 85-foot ladder tower. Both heights agree at 85 feet. facts.design reports both readings and the story does too.

sources.title: Cook County Minnesota Fire Lookout Towers (PDF)

notes_for_editor: Removal date unknown: the Cook list says only 'Removed.' and the latest dated record is a 1956 recovery, so there is no removed event. The Cook list table shows 1928 near the Grand Marais/Good Harbor tower, but the PDF layout is ambiguous, so 1928 is not used. Steel vs ladder is unresolved. 1934 owner was Hedstrom Lumber Co. (private); no current owner or access found. No staffing or fire data found.
